messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
The summary does not state years of experience, and none can be calculated from it. I need that figure before I can rewrite it to match an 8-year requirement.

Not supplying it means I cannot honestly claim the requirement is met. A rewrite that invents “8 years” would misrepresent the candidate; leaving years out leaves a hard requirement unchecked, so the summary is likely to be screened out before the settlement, reconciliation, and inventory work is read.
